text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ever since my last loss, not a night has gone by where my dreams haven't been plagued by its specter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But that nightmare draws to a close today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I've tempered my body with intense training so that I never again have to experience the taste of bitter defeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course. The Empress will be vanquished no more!
